We propose a study that uses input parameter as a bridge: first, review how financial portfolio and portfolio weight are each currently treated through input parameter; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
